dynamic_reconciliation.note: 5 declarations, invoked for escuelas/asignaciones; base appendix details each concrete URL.
password_change and password_change_done; external include, not own literal declarations.

limitations: Literal declarations, including compatibility/inactive modules; not active resolver output.
Imported/inherited class/function definitions traced statically to depth seven. Absence of explicit evidence is not absence of protection.
Signals of services and scope do not prove execution, authorization or coverage.
Router generated paths/actions and dynamic factories need reconciliation with registry and manual definition.
No Django import, services, DB, credentials or runtime request.
Service/test lists are candidates from AST/file names, not executed call graph or asserted coverage.
Assigning every declaration is not an audit of permissions or a migration-completion percentage.
Flow families marked requiere_contrato_por_flujo must be decomposed before implementation.
